title: NormEval: A Meta-Evaluation of Normative Ethics Benchmarks for Large Language Models
description: Complete replication package for the NormEval meta-evaluation: 54-benchmark feature matrix (26 features, 4 axes), composite scoring with hard gates, 15 implementation trials across Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, interactive dashboards (3 versions), and analysis scripts. Cross-vendor extension data (GPT, Gemini) will be deposited separately upon completion of external replication.
notes: SKELETON — Author metadata, version, DOI, and file manifest to be finalized before upload. Cross-vendor (GPT-5, Gemini) data is not included in this deposit; it will be deposited in a separate version upon completion of external model runs.
